text: {"lessons":["I repeatedly sold positions that were up, but a gain alone is not a reason to sell; I should judge each holding by its future prospects and my overall plan.","My average cost is useful for tracking performance, but it does not determine what a stock is worth today or where it will go next.","Because past price changes do not predict future changes and I trade infrequently, I should use a clear, portfolio-level plan rather than reacting to whether each position is above or below my purchase price."]}
